# Worldometer

> Real-time global statistics platform tracking world population, economics, energy, environment, and health metrics across all countries.

Worldometer provides comprehensive demographic, economic, and environmental data sourced from UN, World Bank, IMF, and WHO. The site offers live counters, country rankings, and detailed statistical analysis across multiple languages and topics.

## Key Topics

- world population statistics
- real-time data
- country rankings
- global demographics
- GDP and economics
- CO2 emissions
- energy consumption
- birth and death rates
- population growth
- global statistics
- demographic trends
- United Nations data
- World Bank
- International Monetary Fund
- public health

## Core Statistics

- [Worldometer - Real Time World Statistics](https://www.worldometers.info): Main homepage with live world statistics on population, economics, environment, energy, health
- [Population - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/population): World population statistics and rankings by country with demographic data
- [GDP by Country (2025) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/gdp/gdp-by-country): GDP rankings by country with IMF and World Bank economic data
- [CO2 Emissions - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/co2-emissions): Global CO2 emissions data by country with fossil fuel and climate impact analysis

## Environmental & Resource Data

- [World Energy Statistics - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/energy): Global energy consumption by country with renewable vs fossil fuel breakdown
- [Water Use Statistics - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/water): Global water consumption and freshwater usage statistics by country
- [Food and Agriculture Statistics - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/food-agriculture): Food, agriculture, obesity, forest, and pesticide statistics by country

## Health & Pandemic Data

- [COVID - Coronavirus Statistics - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/coronavirus): COVID-19 pandemic tracker with daily cases, deaths, and historical data

## Reference & Tools

- [Countries of the World by Population - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/geography/countries-of-the-world): Reference data on countries ranked by population with UN demographic statistics
- [What Time Is It? Exact Time Now](https://www.worldometers.info/time): World clock with current time, time zones, and city-specific time data

## International Language Versions

- [Worldometer - Weltstatistiken in Echtzeit](https://www.worldometers.info/de): German language homepage with real-time global statistics
- [Worldometer - Estadísticas mundiales en tiempo real](https://www.worldometers.info/es): Spanish language homepage with real-time global statistics
- [Worldometer - statistik dunia waktu nyata](https://www.worldometers.info/id): Indonesian language homepage with real-time world statistics
- [Worldometer - världsstatistik i realtid](https://www.worldometers.info/da): Danish language homepage with live world statistics and demographics
- [Worldometer - Světové statistiky v reálném čase](https://www.worldometers.info/cs): Czech language homepage with real-time world statistics
- [Worldometer - estadístiques mundials en temps real](https://www.worldometers.info/ca): Catalan language homepage with real-time global statistics
- [Worldometer - reaalajas maailma statistika](https://www.worldometers.info/et): Estonian language homepage with real-time world statistics
